'Most [[Child|kids]] are dead by this age!' Okay, back to work.|Thaddeus, addressing the child laborers|"[[The Profligate]]"}} '''Thaddeus''' is a former aspirant of the [[Knights of San Fernando]] chapter of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] and supporting character {{In|FOTV}}. Initially, he is a bully to his fellow Brotherhood member, [[Maximus]], but then becomes his companion after Maximus assumes [[Titus|Knight Titus']] identity. Eventually, Thaddeus starts transforming into some sort of mutant (he believes himself to be turning into a [[ghoul]], but the mutations he receives imply this is not the case) and is forced to flee the Brotherhood as a result. Fleeing to the Mojave Wasteland, Thaddeus ends up reencountering Maximus and the Brotherhood, and subsequently joins him on his journey to New Vegas. ==Background== Thaddeus was born in the Shithole, a rough side of the [[Los Angeles|Boneyard]]. He grew up on a fly farm; he worked as a "shitter," meaning he would be fed so that he would excrete often, with his feces used to feed the flies, which were then mulched up and sold as protein. Because of this, Thaddeus is self-admittedly somewhat fat.Thaddeus: ''"I've seen some things. I grew up working on a fly farm. I was a shitter, so they'd feed us, and then they'd feed our shit to the flies. Mulch 'em up and sell it as protein. Anyway, that's why I'm so fat."''
({{fotv|1|3}}) Beyond this, Thaddeus implies that his life in the Shithole was also rough, and that he was forced to engage in thievery, violence, and deception to survive. As a result, Thaddeus also does not believe that there are any truly "good" people, having never met any in his life.Thaddeus: ''"We definitely gotta sell it."''
[[Maximus]]: ''"I told you. We'll give it to the right person. A good person."''
Thaddeus: ''"Name a good person, seriously."''
Maximus: ''"That girl I met."''
Thaddeus: ''"The Vault Dweller."''
Maximus: ''"Yeah."''
Thaddeus: ''"[chuckles] Yeah, y'know, uh, I would be a good person too if I grew up on top of a mountain of food, and supplies, in some cozy little impenetrable home. Wouldn't look like this, that's for sure. [sighs] Wouldn't have to steal, and stab, and fib all the goddamn time just to get by. But if we sell it, guess what? Then we'll be rich. And then we'll have the means to be one of those good people you're talking about. 'Cause I've seen a lot o' things. You know, like, crazy things. But 'good people'? No."''
Maximus: ''"Where were you born again, Thaddeus?"''
Thaddeus: ''"Uh, the Boneyard. At the Shithole side of the Boneyard."''
Maximus: ''"I guess I'm the lucky one. Come here from Shady Sands. I remember good people."''
Thaddeus: ''"Well, if you're the lucky one, then we're both screwed. No offense."''
({{FOTV|2|6}}) Thaddeus eventually joined the Knights of San Fernando, a Brotherhood chapter active in the region, and became an [[Initiates#Aspirant|aspirant]]. Among the aspirants, Thaddeus became known as a "consummate bully" who would get together with his friends to pick on others they saw as weak. Thaddeus' main target was Maximus, but this was not personal. Before Maximus came to the base, Thaddeus was the person being bullied by the other aspirants. When Maximus came, Thaddeus saw an opportunity to save himself by proposing that they all gang up on Maximus instead; it worked, and Thaddeus became popular within the Brotherhood ever since, seeing it as a sign of his own growth that he was now the bully and not the bullied. Privately, he still hoped that Maximus would also find someone to beat up eventually, which "only seem[ed] fair" to him.[[Maximus]] (as [[Titus|Knight Titus]]): ''"Say something about him."''
Thaddeus: ''"Well, he, uh, he was a good guy."''
Maximus: ''"Say something negative about him."''
Thaddeus: ''"Well, uh, he-he's dead. I don't know, it feels weird."''
Maximus: ''"An order, my squire."''
Thaddeus: ''"Okay. Uh, to be honest, me and the other guys used to be pretty hard on him. Like, regularly beat the shit out of him. It wasn’t personal, you know. It's just… well, you know, people at the base, they used to beat the shit out of me all the time. This shipment of new recruits came in, and, uh, one of them was Maximus. So I had this funny idea, what if we beat the shit out of that guy instead? And it worked. Yeah, I was really popular. It was great. I just wish he'd lived long enough to find someone else to beat up, you know? Only seems fair. I realize that, uh, people die all the time. It's the law of the Wasteland, so who cares, right? But still, uh, I feel bad."''
Maximus: ''"Don't feel bad. It's like you said, it's the law of the Wasteland. Let's go. We're losing daylight."''
({{fotv|1|3}}) Maximus was later made the squire to [[Titus|Knight Titus]] and sent into the [[Wilds]] on the manhunt for [[Enclave]] deserter [[Siggi Wilzig]]. Maximus was later reported dead to the Brotherhood, and Thaddeus was dispatched to replace him as Titus' squire, though neither he nor the Brotherhood knew that it was actually Titus who died, and that Maximus was impersonating him. The two of them managed to achieve the Brotherhood's mission by retrieving Wilzig's head and the [[Cold fusion|relic]] within; however, Maximus revealed himself to Thaddeus, and the deception caused Thaddeus to turn on him. Thaddeus' foot was mangled, though he managed to trap Maximus by removing his armor's [[Fusion core (TV series)|fusion core]] and flee with Wilzig's head. Unable to walk far with his injury, Thaddeus was able to heal himself by ingesting an [[elixir]] given to him by the [[snake oil salesman]] in exchange for the fusion core. He then went to the [[KPSS radio station]], where he arranged for pickup by the Brotherhood after reporting he had completed his mission. However, he was then confronted by Maximus and [[Lucy MacLean]] for Wilzig's head, and was then shot through the neck by a trap outside the radio station. The trap did not kill Thaddeus; though he did not know it at the time, the snake oil salesman's elixir had given him some additional side effects, making him nearly immune to pain and completely immune to radiation. He displayed abnormal endurance and regenerative properties, and his wound instantly healed. In addition to this, it is shown that he was beginning to [[Mutant|mutate]] into what Maximus believed was a ghoul. This forced Thaddeus to flee from the Brotherhood, though he gave Wilzig's head to Maximus before doing so. Later in 2296, having fled his old life, Thaddeus had taken up a job managing a [[bottle cap]] harvesting operation from a [[Sunset Sarsaparilla factory]], overseeing a group of [[factory children|child laborers]]. However, the factory was attacked by Maximus as well as [[Xander Harkness|Paladin Xander Harkness]], who attempted to kill Thaddeus and his child employees for being ghouls; Maximus killed the paladin to save them. Maximus convinced Thaddeus to disguise himself as Harkness and return to [[Area 51]] with him in order to prevent a war between the Knights of San Fernando and the [[Brotherhood of Steel (Fallout 4)|Commonwealth Brotherhood]]. However, the West Coast chapters at Area 51 ended up fighting each other, and Thaddeus fled with Maximus, who had been given the cold fusion diode by [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]]. The two of them soon encountered [[the Ghoul]], and Thaddeus decided to join them on their journey to [[New Vegas]] to rescue Lucy from the [[Las Vegas management Vault|management Vault]], which required fighting past [[Deathclaw (TV series)|deathclaws]] infesting the [[New Vegas Strip|Strip]]. Though Thaddeus intended to help them, he became unable to when his right arm fell off just outside the Strip, and the other two decided to go on without him. When Maximus was forced into the defensive to protect Freeside, Thaddeus chose to believe in Maximus even when the other [[Freesider]]s did not, stepping up to fulfill his intended role as a sniper despite his lost limb when no one else came to Maximus' aid. Thaddeus is under the impression that he is becoming a ghoul. However, his growing second mouth and sudden loss of an arm imply he is turning into a different type of mutant, though the exact type is not yet known. ==In the TV series== ===Season 1=== {{Quotation|An Initiate{{Ref|(Note)}} of the Brotherhood of Steel and a consummate bully, Thaddeus takes advantage of Maximus' perceived weakness and uses him as a means to build up his own confidence and perceived toughness.|[[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' Season 1 character description]]}} ====[[The End (episode)|The End]]==== Thaddeus is an aspirant of the Brotherhood of Steel alongside Maximus, whom he regularly beats up and bullies with his friends; he is first seen during one such occurrence, fleeing with [[Thaddeus' minion|his minions]] when a cleric spots them. He later celebrates when [[Dane (TV series)|Aspirant Dane]] is assigned to leave for [[the Wilds]] as [[Titus|Knight Titus]]' squire. Still, after Dane is mysteriously injured, he is annoyed at seeing that Maximus is reassigned as Titus' new squire. He later gives Maximus sketches of [[Siggi Wilzig]] and [[CX404]] before Maximus leaves on his mission with Knight Titus.{{FOTV|1|1}} ====[[The Head]]==== Maximus, who has assumed the deceased Knight Titus' identity, is contacted by the Brotherhood of Steel for a status report. To maintain his cover, he tells them his squire died, and Thaddeus is sent as a replacement squire. Maximus pretends to be Knight Titus and, after initially considering killing him, decides to keep Thaddeus as his squire. Under the guise of Knight Titus, Maximus initially bullies Thaddeus the same way Knight Titus bullies him and finds it amusing to bully his former bully. Thaddeus is eager to please "Knight Titus" and tries to be as helpful to him as much as possible. The pair find Wilzig's headless corpse, which they believe to be [[the Ghoul]]'s doing. Believing Wilzig's head to be a thing of value and in The Ghoul's possession, Thaddeus comes up with the idea to use a device to track The Ghoul's radiation. During their journey, Maximus presses Thaddeus to disclose his opinion of him, and Thaddeus reveals the reason why he bullied Maximus and that it wasn't personal. Although he realizes that "it's the law of the [[wasteland]]" and people die all the time, he feels bad that Maximus died before things could get better for him. Maximus tells Thaddeus not to feel bad, as he reiterates that "it's the law of the wasteland." They eventually arrive on [[Hollywood Boulevard]], where they are attacked by a [[Gulper (TV series)|gulper]]. Maximus rebukes Thaddeus for leading them to danger but orders him to run to safety while he personally deals with the gulper. While attempting to take the creature down, Maximus runs out of ammo from his pistol and is about to fight in close-quarter combat; Thaddeus aids him and shoots the gulper with a rifle. However, this alerts the gulper to Thaddeus' location, and he is chased down and dragged by the beast. The gulper nearly swallows Thaddeus, but Maximus comes to aid Thaddeus by grabbing him and pulling him out of the beast's mouth from the opposite side. The tug of war causes the gulper to vomit and die. While recovering from the situation, they find the target (Wilzig's head) to be among the things the gulper vomited and being licked by [[CX404]], who had been searching for Wilzig as well. They celebrate at the sight of this and prepare to return the head to the Brotherhood.{{fotv|1|3}} ====[[The Past]]==== [[File:The Past Maximus and Thaddeus.png|thumb|250px|Maximus and Thaddeus]] While sitting around a campfire celebrating their success, Thaddeus requests that Maximus, who he still thinks is Titus, brand him. After the branding, Maximus reveals his identity to Thaddeus. Since Thaddeus and Maximus grew close during their journey, Maximus hoped that Thaddeus would corroborate a made-up story that would help him avoid punishment from the Brotherhood. When Thaddeus asks Maximus what happened to Knight Titus, and he reveals that Titus is dead, Thaddeus tells Maximus that the Brotherhood will uncover his deceit and will kill him for it. Seeing that Thaddeus refuses to participate in his scheme, Maximus attacks Thaddeus and crushes his foot, but Thaddeus manages to remove the [[Fusion core (TV series)|fusion core]] from Maximus' [[T-60 power armor (TV series)|power armor]]. Thaddeus then steals Wilzig's head and escapes, leaving Maximus trapped in his armor to die alone.{{fotv|1|5}} Lucy later rescues Maximus, and they begin tracking Thaddeus to get the head from him. ====[[The Radio]]==== While traveling with Siggi Wilzig's head and an injured foot, Thaddeus stops at a [[Red Rocket (TV series)|Red Rocket]] to check on his foot. Seeing it mangled, he realizes that he will die without medical assistance. He decides to leave behind most of his squire equipment apart from a pistol and Wilzig's head. He also leaves CX404 inside a Nuka-Cola fridge to stop her from following him, but only after making sure she can still breathe in the fridge. He then begins looking for a radio tower to contact the Brotherhood for pickup, tracking [[Carl (TV series)|DJ Carl]]'s signal from the [[KPSS radio station]]. Thaddeus later encounters the [[snake oil salesman]] and trades him the fusion core from Maximus' power armor for a "[[elixir|serum]]" to heal his foot. He initially contemplates shooting the salesman and taking the serums for himself, but the salesman talks him out of it, saying he would not know which serums would harm him and which would not. The serum heals Thaddeus's foot, and once the process is complete, he asks the salesman if there is a radio tower nearby so that he may contact the [[Brotherhood base]]. He responds by telling Thaddeus that one is near the ruins of Shady Sands, which the soldier notes as being radioactive. Before slapping his shoulder and parting ways, the salesman says that Thaddeus will not have to worry about the radiation anymore.Thaddeus: ''"Do you know where I can find a radio tower? I have to make contact with my base."''
[[Snake oil salesman]]: ''"Yes, I believe there's one yonward. Past the big crater in the middle of the Shithole. It's near a town that used to be called Shady Sands."''
Thaddeus: ''"Shady Sands? That place is radioactive as hell."''
Snake oil salesman: ''"Well, you don't have to worry about that anymore, do you, buddy boy? Toodles and anon."''
({{fotv|1|7}}) Thaddeus eventually reaches the KPSS station and talks Carl into letting him borrow his radio tower to contact the Brotherhood, after which they talk about Carl's music for a while. Eventually, Lucy and Maximus arrive at the radio station, startling Thaddeus, who fires an entire magazine's worth of rounds at them but misses every shot. He then accidentally sets off a trap, lodging a [[crossbow (TV series)|crossbow]] bolt in his neck. Surprised that he hasn't died, Thaddeus takes out the crossbow bolt, only for his wound to be instantaneously healed. Maximus suspects that Thaddeus may be turning into a [[ghoul]], causing Thaddeus to be distressed, as the Brotherhood of Steel will surely kill him now. With the Brotherhood already en route to him, Maximus instructs Thaddeus to give him the head, and he will return to the Brotherhood to slow them down so Thaddeus can escape to safety. Thaddeus thanks Maximus and gives the two abrupt apologies and farewells.{{fotv|1|7}} ===Season 2=== {{Quotation|Once an Initiate{{Ref|(Note)}} of the Brotherhood of Steel and a bully with his sights set on Maximus, Thaddeus has since undergone some serious transformation (both figuratively and LITERALLY).|[[Fallout season 2 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' season 2 character description]]}} ====[[The Profligate]]==== Sometime after his escape from KPSS, the visibly mutated Thaddeus took control of an abandoned [[Sunset Sarsaparilla]] bottling factory close to [[New Vegas]], which he used as a shelter. The plant was also apparently housing an [[extremely broken Securitron]] that Thaddeus kept around for "security." He eventually decided to create a cap collecting operation; to maximize profit, he installed himself as floor manager and gathered a "crew" of orphaned human and ghoul children to man the conveyor belts bringing out crates of soda so they could pry off the caps while drinking the leftover soda for refreshment. The quiet living Thaddeus was enjoying was eventually upended when the bottling factory was stormed by Maximus and [[Xander Harkness]] from the Commonwealth Brotherhood after they detected the plant's power signature. They destroyed the Securitron and discovered the crew of children, which Xander wanted to eliminate the ghouls in accordance with the Codex. Thaddeus tried to intervene to protect them, but Xander's refusal to back down forced Maximus to kill him by driving a [[Super sledge (TV series)|super sledge]] into his head. As Xander's body collapses, Maximus reveals himself to Thaddeus and they quickly catch up, with Thaddeus still in shock from nearly dying. ====[[The Demon in the Snow]]==== Maximus tells Thaddeus he has to help him cover up Xander's death from the Brotherhood, just as a vertibird arrives, having tracked Xander and Maximus. Despite initial reluctance, claiming he prefers to run away, Thaddeus agrees to help after Max points out the Brotherhood would discover the kids in the process of looking for him, killing the ghouls and recruiting the humans, if they did not create a distraction. Thaddeus takes Maximus' suit of T-60 power armor and disguises himself as Xander Harkness as they are flown back to [[Area 51]]. His complete inexperience in using the armor and nervous comments are enough to fool [[Gnatius|Knight Gnatius]] and others, but it immediately tips off [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]] to Xander's death once they arrive back at Area 51. Max embarks on a plan to kill Quintus to prevent war with the Commonwealth, asking Dane to provide support; Thaddeus simply continues acting "as normal" as the paladin. Thaddeus fails to remain discreet, loudly vocalizing his nervous thoughts through his helmet while at the mess hall, which earns him glances from the confused Brotherhood members present. He decides that the risk of coming back to the Brotherhood is not worth it and tries to leave, but is met by [[McRae|Elder McRae]] of the [[Yosemite Brotherhood of Steel]], who asks for an audience with "Xander," which he is forced to agree to. McRae tries to convince "Xander" to put in a good word with [[Arthur Maxson|Elder Maxson]] after her chapter's involvement with [[Quintus]], but they are then interrupted by the [[Coronado elder]], who also tries to make a deal. In the tense situation, Thaddeus suffers a panic attack and is almost exposed when McRae offers to lift his visor to help him breathe until the [[Grand Canyon elder]] storms in, revealing the cold fusion relic was stolen and kick-starting an all-out war between the chapters. Thaddeus quickly removes himself from the situation. He finds Maximus and Dane after the former reneges on his plan to kill Quintus. The two separate from Dane and flee from the base with the cold fusion relic in Maximus' hands as the airship fleet opens fire on one another, with one crashing into the desert behind them. ====[[The Other Player]]==== The combat continues at Area 51. In the sand dunes some distance from the base, Thaddeus has exited the T-60 power armor he was wearing due to Maximus' warning that the Brotherhood has trackers in its power armor and would be able to find them if they kept it. Seeing Maximus observe the vial with the cold fusion diode, Thaddeus sits behind him, marveling at the "sacred remnant." However, Maximus is surprised when Thaddeus' first instinct is that they should sell the diode. Maximus shuts him down, but Thaddeus continues to try and persuade him as the two start walking further into the distance. Later at night, the two have walked out of the sand dunes and reached an area with dry brush and ramshackle buildings, where they have set up a campfire. When Maximus still refuses to sell the diode, saying they will give it to a "good person" instead, Thaddeus challenges Maximus by asking him to name a "good person." Maximus mentions Lucy, but Thaddeus scoffs at this, believing that Lucy's "goodness" was only possible because she lived in a Vault and thus had guaranteed safety and abundant resources, in his view. He believes that he would not have been forced to resort to violence to survive, or have become a ghoul, if he grew up in a Vault like Lucy had. His ultimate claim is that, if they sold the diode, they could achieve the means to become "good" like Lucy; otherwise, in Thaddeus' view, he has never seen a good person before in his life. Hearing this, Maximus asks Thaddeus where he came from, learning that Thaddeus was from the Shithole; Maximus responds that he was comparably "lucky" to have grown up in Shady Sands and remembers good people. However, Thaddeus sarcastically points out that Maximus was not much luckier than him. After some time, Thaddeus and Maximus have fallen asleep next to their campfire. Dogmeat approaches them, carrying [[the Ghoul]]'s hat in her mouth, she barks, jolting them awake. Dogmeat starts walking away, and Maximus and Thaddeus begin following her, having recognized her from before. They follow her to the [[Mojave Mission School]], where they discover the Ghoul lying wounded in one of the buildings. Maximus and the Ghoul curse in annoyance at finding each other there, while Thaddeus just awkwardly greets and waves hello. They stand there, looking over the Ghoul, as the episode ends. ====[[The Handoff]]==== Thaddeus, along with the Ghoul and Maximus, enter an [[run-down town|abandoned NCR town]]. Thaddeus attempts to talk with the Ghoul, trying to bond, as he is under the impression that he is becoming a ghoul just like the bounty hunter, but the Ghoul ignores him. When Maximus asks the Ghoul where they are going, the Ghoul tells them that they are going to [[New Vegas]] to save Lucy; however, Thaddeus points out that New Vegas is in an opposite direction from them. The Ghoul explains that they need equipment to get past the deathclaws on the New Vegas Strip. The Ghoul then turns and points his gun at Maximus, demanding he explain why he has the cold fusion diode. Thaddeus mostly stays out of their conversation, apart from urging caution at pointing out the obvious, that the Ghoul has a gun. [[File:FTV S2E7 Still 065.png|thumb|250px|Thaddeus growing a mouth on his body.]] The three enter a former NCR armory in the town. Thaddeus grabs a hunting rifle and again tries to talk to the Ghoul, even showing him that he is growing a second mouth. He asks the Ghoul if it is normal, but the Ghoul only looks at him, wide-eyed, and returns to equipping himself. Thaddeus, dejected from not getting any answers, asks if a scope is around. Thaddeus watches as Maximus subsequently gives up the cold fusion diode to the Ghoul in exchange for getting access to a suit of [[Ranger power armor|NCR Ranger power armor]]. Sometime later, the three arrive in [[Freeside]], approaching the [[New Vegas Strip]] gate to deal with the deathclaws. They are cheered on by the crowd of [[Freesider|Freeside residents]] around them at the sight of a figure wearing NCR-marked armor. Thaddeus expresses confusion at this, but is told by the Ghoul that it is due to their "brand recognition" of the NCR. Once they reach the gate to the Strip, Thaddeus is told to get into position as a sniper. However, his right arm falls off, leaving him unable to fulfill his role. Despite insisting he can still help, Maximus tells him to stay back, and the others go forward without him. ====[[The Strip]]==== Thaddeus and the other gathered Freesiders watch as Maximus is thrown back by the deathclaws. Seeing the deathclaws start to enter Freeside, Maximus tells Thaddeus and the other townspeople to get to safety, and Thaddeus tries to help hurry them along, before running into the Atomic Wrangler alongside [[Shotgun Jeff]], Dogmeat, and many other Freesiders. The Freesiders soon start betting on Maximus' survival, despite knowing that his loss would mean they all die. Aggravated that most of the Freesiders do not think Maximus will win, Thaddeus silences the crowd and instead bets 500 caps on Maximus' survival, spilling a large number of caps from inside his clothes which he reveals he had been carrying from when he "used to make money for a living" at the Sunset Sarsaparilla factory. As Maximus is worn down over time, Thaddeus grows concerned, and takes it upon himself to join the fight like he was supposed to despite the loss of his arm. By bracing his rifle with his foot, Thaddeus provides sniper support to Maximus, though he struggles to reload his rifle due to his condition. Thaddeus manages to kill one, but Maximus is soon forced to abandon his armor and face down a deathclaw while Thaddeus is stuck reloading. To both of their surprise, [[New California Republic|NCR]] forces arrive to join the battle, turning the tide against the deathclaws. ==Personality== Thaddeus is eager to please his superiors and can be friendly and loyal to people if it does not get him in trouble. However, like Maximus, he also has a strong sense of self-preservation, as expressed by the actions he admits having taken for survival in the Shithole; in his having targeted Maximus as a victim for bullying among the aspirants; and in how he left Maximus for dead after discovering he had been disguised as Titus, and intending to finish the mission for the Brotherhood himself. Thaddeus did not enjoy bullying Maximus; he did it only because he wanted to fit in with his peers and because he sought to escape being a bullying victim himself, believing this to be the "law of the wasteland." Thaddeus' experiences have made him cynical, believing that there are no truly good people in the wasteland, and that goodness is only possible for those who have lived in abundance and who thus had the means to "become" good. While initially loyal to the Brotherhood, he was not a fanatical believer in their ideals, as seen by his quick abandonment of his Brotherhood ties, alongside his rivalry with Maximus, upon discovering he may have become a ghoul. Understanding the Brotherhood's "shoot on sight" approach to mutants, he willingly hands over Siggi Wilzig's head and flees, having lost any hostility to Maximus, as there was no longer anything gained by continuing to oppose him. Despite his cynicism, Thaddeus still willingly endangered himself to try and protect the ghoul children working under him from being killed by Paladin Harkness. He did so despite having no means of escaping the situation if not for Maximus' intervention. Later on, after meeting the Ghoul, he seemed eager to get along with him as a "fellow ghoul" and showed some concern and confusion over how he was mutating. Upon losing an arm when preparing to fight against the deathclaws on the Strip, he seemed only slightly surprised, and insisted he could still fight, but was left behind. ==Appearances== Thaddeus appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances |1=101 |3=103 |5=105 |7=107 |11=203 |12=204 |14=206 |15=207 |16=208 }} ==Behind the scenes== {{Note|(Note)}} Though Thaddeus' descriptions on Amazon Prime Video for both [[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|season 1]] and [[Fallout season 2 Amazon overview|season 2]] call him an "initiate" in the Brotherhood, this is not used anywhere else in the TV series (apart from a description for [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]] on the same website).
